push_switch.note: OEM page 1 specification says 0.5 +/-0.3; page 2 drawing says 0.5 +0.4/-0.3. Reserve at least 0.9 travel plus design clearance; do not collapse this discrepancy.

pcb_notes: Hole/slot values are OEM recommended PCB mounting hole dimensions. Copper annuli and any plated shell-pad choice must be added by PCB designer.
Encoder A-C-B adjacent pitch 2.5 mm, outer A-B span 5.0. Switch contacts span 5.0 mm.

OEM 12.8 callout runs between the outside edges of the two 1.4-wide slots (not their center lines). Center-to-center distance = 12.8 - 1.4 = 11.4, giving x=±5.7 about shaft center. Encoder A-B total span is 5.0, giving A/C/B x=-2.5/0/+2.5.
Five signal pin insertion length is nominal 3.0 mm below body seating plane.
OEM general dimension tolerance: <10 mm +/-0.3; >=10 mm +/-0.5 unless explicitly stated.
Manufacturer recommends wave soldering Sn95.5/Ag2.8/Cu0.7, no-clean flux, 260 +/-5 C for 3-5 seconds. Hand soldering not recommended.
